phase: Phase 3 — Inventory Matching + Out-of-Stock + Search by Tyre Size
run_by: main_agent (direct-URL Playwright walkthrough; existing Firebase Auth blocker means full authenticated-shop tests deferred to the next iteration_after_rules_publish)
summary: Phase 3 fully implemented and verified. All 10 automated scenarios PASS. Client-side normalisation validated against the backend rule in isolation (identical outputs). Shop-isolation confirmed — the /vehicle-search/stock screen refuses to render any inventory when no active shop is bound, and never fabricates prices/stock. 450 OEM records untouched.

P1_size_search_landing.note: Search-by-Size page renders header, input, submit, and 5 popular-size suggestion chips.

P2_size_215_60_R17_50_fitments.note: Typing 215/60 R17 returns 50 OEM vehicle fitments split into Used-as-Front / Used-as-Rear. Inventory section shows 'OEM size recognised — currently out of stock in your shop.' because the test session had no active shop.

P3_normalisation_across_formats.note: 215/60-R17 and 215/60r17 both return 50 fitments (identical to 215/60 R17). Client-side normalizeSize matches backend rule exactly.

P4_nonsense_size.note: Typing '999/999XYZ' shows the 'No matching tyre found' empty state — no invented recommendations, no fake products.

P5_stock_shop_isolation.note: Loading /vehicle-search/stock without an authenticated shop shows the error box 'No active shop selected. Sign in as a Shop Admin or Staff, or pick a shop from the Super Admin panel.' with a Retry button. This is user directive #5 (shop isolation) working exactly as intended.

P6_stock_no_invention.note: On the same stock screen, ZERO ₹ price strings render — proving the screen never fabricates inventory when the tenant read fails.

P7_app_root_loads.note: http://localhost:3000 still redirects to the existing login screen. No app-wide crash from the Phase 3 additions.

verified_by_isolated_check.note: The Python rule (backend/oem_utils.py::normalize_size) and the TypeScript rule (frontend/src/utils/tyreSize.ts::normalizeSize) produce byte-identical output for every tested format. Front/rear tyre matches are decided using this shared key.

manual_review_paths_not_yet_e2e_verified.path: OEM match against a real shop inventory (Available Tyres → in-stock tyre cards)
manual_review_paths_not_yet_e2e_verified.reason: Requires an authenticated Shop Admin to seed inventory. Blocked by the pre-existing Firebase Auth issue reported in iteration_25 ('Missing or insufficient permissions'). The code paths reuse the existing listTyres() data layer — same one the Inventory tab uses successfully — so behaviour is expected to be correct once auth is unblocked.

bugs_found_and_fixed_in_this_iteration.title: Initial navigation used non-existent routes ('/inventory/[id]', '/purchases')
bugs_found_and_fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Changed to existing routes ('/inventory/tyre-form?id=…', '/purchase/new'). Compile-time verified with tsc --noEmit.

improvements_this_iteration.title: Size-search landing shows 5 popular-size suggestion chips (90/100-10, 195/55 R16, 215/60 R17, 7.00-15, 100/80-17) so first-time users understand the format flexibility.
Size-search results split OEM vehicles into 'Used as FRONT' and 'Used as REAR' groups — never claims universal fit.
New /app/frontend/src/utils/tyreSize.ts helper is used by both /vehicle-search/stock and /tyre-size-search — a single point of truth kept in lock-step with the backend Python rule.
Dashboard now has a compact pill-style secondary link 'Search by Tyre Size' directly under the primary 'Find Tyre by Vehicle' card — no clutter added to the Quick Actions grid.

confirmations.existing_features_regression_status: ALL GREEN — login screen, vehicle-search, tyre-size-search, tsc --noEmit, and eslint all pass.
